Production: 1962 - 1964 Total made: 36 Engine: 3,0 litre V12 (petrol) Power: 300 PS Gearbox: 5 speed manual Layout: front engine, rear drive Location: Lime Rock Park, Connecticut (USA)

Chassis #3769GT, finished in grey metallic with a blue stripe, was completed on 13 Jun 1962. Ten days later it suffered at DNF at the 24 Hours of Le Mans but it went on to compete until 1966. Its first victory was first in the GT class (5th overall) at the 1962 Cote de Macon-Solutré on 15 July. A week later, it placed first overall on 23 July at the Rallye Lyons-La Foret.

Its final victory (first in class) was at the VI. Rallye deux Catalognes in Barcelona on 23 Oct 1965.
